probes.scenario: Given an empty account A, When 10 is deposited into A, Then A's balance is 10
Given account A with balance 100, When 10 is withdrawn from A, Then the withdrawal is accepted and A's balance drops by 10 plus the 0.50 minimum fee, to 89.50
Given an empty account A, When -5 is deposited into A, Then the operation is rejected and A's balance stays 0
Given account A with 100 and empty account B, When 30 is transferred from A to B, Then A has 70 and B has 30
Given account A with 100, When 10 is transferred from A to A, Then the transfer is rejected
Given account A, When 100 is deposited (t1) and then 30 transferred from A to B (t2), Then A's history records both operations t1 and t2
Given an empty account A, When a deposit of 10 with txn id t1 is submitted twice, Then A's balance is 10, not 20
Given an empty account A, When 1.234 is deposited, Then A's balance is held in whole cents as 1.23
Given an empty account A, When 1.005 is deposited, Then the half cent rounds away from zero and A's balance is 1.01
Given account A with 200, When 100 is withdrawn, Then a 1% fee of 1.00 is charged and A's balance is 99
Given account A with 100, When 10 is withdrawn, Then A's history holds a withdrawal entry of 10 and a separate fee entry of 0.50 (three entries in all)
Given an empty account A, When 1 unit of foreign currency is deposited at rate 0.125 (exactly 0.125), Then the half cent rounds to even and A's balance is 0.12
Given account A with 1000, When interest at 3.65% annual is credited for 10 days, Then 1000 * 0.0365 * 10 / 365 = 1.00 is credited and A's balance is 1001
Given account A with 90, When 90 is split between B, C and D, Then each of B, C and D receives 30 and A has 0
